title: Structure and minimum size

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Keep letter-to-frame proportions and minimum scale explicit so a familiar mark stays legible when reproduced.
strategic_value: A fixed frame relationship can preserve Helsinki’s signature across print and screen sizes.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section pairs two H-based construction drawings with written print/screen width guidance and a 25 mm print-width specimen.
practical_value: Check both the mark’s fixed proportions and the reproduction medium before sizing it.

content_islands.name: Construction and rules
content_islands.spec: Place fixed-proportion and minimum-size text above two H-based drawings.

content_islands.name: Print-width specimen
content_islands.spec: Finish with a framed logo dimensioned 25 mm; the 200-pixel screen recommendation appears in the text.

ingredient.name: Logo proportions and size
ingredient.role: Preserve the signature’s shape and legibility.
ingredient.application: Use original fixed proportions; keep print width at least 25 mm and follow the recommended 200-pixel screen minimum.
ingredient.scope: Print minimum is mandatory; screen minimum is a recommendation. H width controls internal text/frame distance.

reference_purposes.Application: The drawings explain the fixed text/frame relationship and H-based distance.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Minimum print width is 25 mm; the screen minimum of 200 pixels is recommended.
